description: A spectrum analyser for two signals: a 2048-point Hann-windowed transform of each, drawn in decibels over a linear or logarithmic frequency axis

params.text: Scales the height of the orange trace, eleven whole-number positions from -5 to 5, each one drawing twice as tall as the one below it
Moves the orange trace up and down the display, -1 to +1 added to its scaled height
Scales the height of the green trace, eleven whole-number positions from -5 to 5, each one drawing twice as tall as the one below it
Moves the green trace up and down the display, -1 to +1 added to its scaled height
Narrows the band of frequencies drawn, 1 to 8, with 1 showing everything up to half the sample rate
Switches the frequency axis between linear and logarithmic on each press, the two lamps showing which one is in use
Slides the drawn band along the frequency axis, 0 at the bottom of the range and 1 at the top; it changes nothing while the zoom is at 1
Stops and restarts the analysis on each press, the lamp showing when it is running; with both input jacks empty it is off and cannot be turned on

inputs.text: The signal drawn as the orange trace
The signal drawn as the green trace

outputs.text: The first input passed straight through, unchanged, for carrying that signal on
The second input passed straight through, unchanged, for carrying that signal on

notes: the readout marked Peak f gives the number of the loudest transform bin, not a frequency; multiply it by the sample rate and divide by 2048 to get hertz
a transform is taken once every 2048 input samples, so the picture is redrawn from new data only that often
magnitudes are drawn as 20 times the base-ten logarithm of the magnitude plus 0.01, which puts the floor of a silent channel at -40dB

outputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the first input, unchanged.
outputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the second input, unchanged.
